articles.title: Kluivert and Rayan rock Real Sociedad as Bournemouth win on European bow
articles.summary: The first goal that AFC Bournemouth ever scored in Europe could be heard out on the Bay of Biscay. A tradition from Real Sociedad’s old Atotxa ground, once lost but now recovered at Anoeta, dictates that a single flare is set off every time the visitors score while two are lit when the home team…
body: Back in Dorset and high in Anoeta, where 2,000 Bournemouth fans sang their way through this most special of occasions, they knew. They had waited their whole lives for this and it was a nice way to mark the history they made, their arrival announced to Europe with fireworks and a 2-1 victory in San Sebastián, the city where it all began for Andoni Iraola, the manager who brought them here.

Iturralde ran into the night three times – he went once more when Rayan made it 2-0 after 20 minutes and again when Sergio Gómez made it 2-1 on 57 – and might have gone more too. After a superb first half, Bournemouth had to hang on, sometimes desperately, in the second. For a while it had seemed a lead would slip away from their grasp for the fifth time in six games this season, but Djordje Petrovic came to their rescue with two astonishing saves from Orri Óskarsson in the final, dramatic minutes. They had done it, everyone at the final whistle. It had been some battle and they had given everything.

articles.title: Pino kickstarts Crystal Palace’s Europa League rout of Lech Poznan to ease Sage’s worries
articles.summary: It was worth the wait for Crystal Palace. After being denied their rightful place in the Europa League last season, Pierre Sage’s side made the perfect debut by brushing aside Lech Poznan with a victory that will take some of the heat off their new manager.
body: The Frenchman has big shoes to fill in replacing Oliver Glasner after his predecessor won three trophies in the space of 12 months and there had been some talk of disquiet behind the scenes following his decision to drop the teenager Jaydee Canvot at the weekend. But while Palace face a testing trip to face in-form Leeds on Sunday, having conceded 11 goals from their opening four Premier League matches, they were given a big helping hand by their opponents here well before Radoslaw Murawski was sent off late on for a reckless foul on Canvot.

The result was never in doubt after Poznan gifted Yéremy Pino a goal direct from their own throw-in, with Chris Richards and a Jørgen Strand Larsen penalty making the points safe by half-time. Eddie Nketiah rounded off the win with a late fourth and Sage was delighted to have shared in Palace’s historic moment before a meeting with his former club Lyon next month.
“I saw a lot of videos about the fans, especially during the journey in the Conference League last year,” he said. “They were incredible and I want to share the same thing with them this year.”

articles.title: Chicago Stars make a splash as Vlatko Andonovski joins as chief soccer officer
articles.summary: Former USWNT head coach will start role immediately. Andonovski has won two NWSL championships. Former Kansas City Current sporting director Vlatko Andonovski is already back in the NWSL, with the Chicago Stars announcing Thursday that he has been hired as the chief soccer officer of the last-place…
body: Andonovski’s tenure with the Current had ended just 10 days ago, as the team announced a mutual contract termination in a tersely worded press release that deemed his sporting director position to be “not the right fit”. As a head coach, Andonovski won two NWSL Coach of the Year awards and two NWSL championships. He has won consistent praise for his ability to built trust with players and staff – a significant trait in a league with a history of allegations of misconduct by coaches at the professional level.

The move is a much-needed boost for the Stars, who have won just five games this season. The team also finished last in 2025. Richard Feuz, hired as general manager in 2024, was fired earlier this year. Martin Sjögren, Feuz’s hire as head coach before the 2026 season, was let go in August.

The hiring of Andonovski comes as the club seeks to stabilize itself off the field. The Stars have played this season at Northwestern University in Evanston, Illinois and will continue there in 2027 as they seek a new stadium downtown. An ownership consortium headlined by Chicago Cubs co-owner Laura Ricketts bought the team in 2023 at a $35.5m valuation.

articles.title: 'Just the beginning' - Samba, 17, steals Man City show
articles.summary: Floyd Samba's scintillating debut stole the show at Etihad Stadium but also took the headlines away from another high-profile teenager in Manchester.
body: Website articles, social media posts and column inches have been filled this week with the news that highly rated 15-year-old forward JJ Gabriel is on the verge of leaving Manchester United.

But that particular saga will be overshadowed in Friday's football cuttings by 17-year-old Samba's stunning bow on the professional stage, scoring twice in Manchester City's 5-0 Carabao Cup third-round thrashing of Norwich City.
Samba was prolific in City's under-18 side last season and those impressive performances led to him being promoted to the first-team set-up by new manager Enzo Maresca this summer.
"I knew there would be an opportunity to get some minutes for the first time with the first team," Samba told BBC Radio 5 Live. "To get a debut like that is mind-blowing.

articles.title: Champion Van Gerwen loses in first round to Gurney
articles.summary: Defending champion Michael van Gerwen falls to a 6-5 defeat by Daryl Gurney in the opening round of the World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam.
body: Northern Ireland's Gurney raced into a 3-0 lead before the Dutch top seed reeled off five consecutive legs to put himself on the brink of victory.
However, Gurney, who was drafted in as a late replacement when Lourence Ilagan withdrew from the 32-man field, responded by taking the ninth leg.
And when Van Gerwen missed six match darts, he was able to level the match at 5-5 and win the decider with the throw.
Gurney will now take on England's Ross Smith in the last 16 on Saturday after he advanced past Kevin Doets 6-3.

articles.title: Federal Judge Dismisses Matt Kalil’s Privacy Lawsuit Against Haley Kalil
articles.summary: On Thursday, U.S. District Judge Patrick Schiltz dismissed the invasion of privacy suit brought by former NFL offensive lineman Matt Kalil against his former wife, model and influencer Haley Kalil, because he found her sexual descriptions about their married life made during a Twitch livestream…
body: According to the order, Haley Kalil made the comments while talking about her marriage and divorce, and Judge Schiltz said she was talking about herself, not Matt Kalil. In his view, the law usually protects speech about oneself, even when it exposes facts about another person.

Matt Kalil, 36, demanded at least $ 75,000 in damages in the suit he filed in January in federal court in Minnesota, court documents analyzed by TMZ Sports show. He said the comments hurt his efforts to stay out of the limelight after his football career ended and made derogatory comments about his family.

The suit was based on a November 2025 livestream with content creator Marlon Garcia, according to the judge’s order. Haley Kalil, 33, did not mention Matt Kalil by name in her comments; however, she described him as “the greatest guy in the world” and said the two remained friends, according to the order. Moreover, she mentioned therapy sessions and doctors, mentioned anatomical incompatibility which, according to her, was the biggest reason for the divorce, and said that every attempt at intercourse made her cry.

articles.title: England crush Sri Lanka to seal T20 series win
articles.summary: England comfortably chase a below-par target of 146 to thrash Sri Lanka by six wickets and seal the three-match T20 series with a game to spare.
body: England's impressive T20 form continued as they thrashed Sri Lanka by six wickets in Cardiff to seal the series with a match to spare.
Tom Banton's unbeaten 52 ensured England made light work of chasing a below-par 146, reaching the target in just 12.1 overs.

Jos Buttler and Aneurin Donald raced to an opening stand of 51 in 4.3 overs before they both fell in the space of four balls for 30 and 21 respectively, but England's middle order followed suit in their aggression.

Captain Harry Brook needed to score 49 to break Tilak Varma's record of 336 T20 international runs without being dismissed, and he looked on course, whacking three sixes in his 23 off just eight balls, before he was brilliantly caught by a diving Eshan Malinga.

articles.title: Real Sociedad 1-2 Bournemouth: What Rose said
articles.summary: Bournemouth boss Marco Rose, speaking to TNT Sports: "It was very intense and tough. Brilliant first half in everything. The way we won balls and the possession high up. In the second half, we needed to suffer because we were not so sharp. We need to talk about the second half.
body: On the intensity: "That's Bournemouth football. We want to be active and defend forward. We want to create chances. We had a header to be 3-0 up. The game is 90 minutes and the first half was really brilliant.

On losing intensity: "It's not about the games because we didn't play so much so far, we just started. It's about the mindset. We lack a bit of intensity and if you lose this kind of thing in our style, then we know. If you get tired, then we need to change with substitutes.
"It's a brilliant win in our first European game. It's brilliant for the club and the 2000 fans from Bournemouth."
Bournemouth have led in all six of their games in all competitions under Marco Rose, with this just their second win along with a 4-0 victory over Lincoln City in the EFL Cup.

articles.summary: Michael van Gerwen's title defence at the World Series of Darts Finals came to an end in the first round after he was beaten 6-5 by Daryl Gurney.
body: Van Gerwen missed six match darts at 5-4 up before being taken to a deciding leg which Northern Ireland's Gurney controlled despite boos and whistles from the Amsterdam crowd.
It is just the second time Van Gerwen has lost his first match at the event as his difficult 2026 season continued.
"It was really hard work. I can't remember the last time I won on a major stage," said Gurney, who has largely struggled to perform on the big stage in recent years outside of the World Cup of Darts.
"I put my darts away twice because Michael had six [match] darts. In all honesty, I was very lucky to even go 5-5 and I had the throw I was like 'please I need trebles'."

articles.title: Peyton Watson makes a stellar first impression in Cleveland
articles.summary: First impressions are everything. Peyton Watson made sure to leave a good one during his introductory press conference with the Cleveland Cavaliers. “I’m just Peyton Watson, and you can guarantee that I’m gonna show up on a nightly basis and affect winning.” That’s a bold statement from a…
body: That’s a bold statement from a 23-year-old making his introduction to a new team. But this press conference tells us that Watson knows exactly who he needs to be in the next chapter of his career.
“We have such a talented group of guys already; you don’t have to change much about that team; that team is successful and has the DNA to win games,” said Watson.

“But I feel like I can be a great addition to this team not only as a locker room presence, but defensively and offensively; I want to be someone who can affect the games and make it easier for the guys who have already been winning here.”
Being self-aware is more important than you might think. Especially in team sports.

articles.title: MK Dons still searching for first win after goalless draw at Wimbledon
articles.summary: MK Dons are without a win in seven League One games this season after being held to a 0-0 draw by AFC Wimbledon at the Cherry Red Records Stadium.
body: The hosts could have taken an early lead when Myles Hippolyte put Callum Maycock through on goal but his effort sailed over the crossbar.
They went close again in the 11th minute when Jayden Stockley flicked a header into the path of Steve Seddon, whose effort at the back post forced a superb save from Will Dennis.
The ball fell at the feet of Callum Paterson in the 32nd minute, only for the MK Dons star to fire a shot straight down the throat of Joe Bursik.
After a fiery start to the second half, Bursik made another crucial intervention to clear Aaron Collins' cut-back before it drifted into the path of Sam Nombe.

articles.title: Chris Samba's son Floyd shines on debut as Man City ease past Norwich
articles.summary: Floyd Samba enjoyed a dream debut by scoring twice as holders Manchester City booked their place in the Carabao Cup fourth round with a 5-0 home win over Norwich.
body: Samba, 17, the son of former Premier League defender Chris, introduced himself in perfect style with his stooping header to open the scoring before Rayan Cherki doubled City's lead soon after.

Having assisted the first for Samba, fellow debutant Allan joined in on the scoring after dancing into the box and driving a low shot into the bottom corner to mark another emphatic introduction to the home fans at the Etihad Stadium.
Samba built on his strong start to life in the senior squad, as his father watched on from the stands, when he calmly curled home a fourth goal for City.

Norwich were denied a consolation goal when substitute Mohamed Toure's effort was disallowed for offside, meaning the visitors walked away without a shot on target registered, and Ryan McAidoo would add to their misery with a late goal to make it five for the hosts.
